pages.text: Akaishi Hunting Ring (ring slot, 100k buffer): a 15% chance per kill to drop 1 Akaishi Crystal directly into the inventory. $(bold)No energy is consumed.$(reset)

Akaishi Gathering Bracelet (hands slot, 100k buffer): a 5% chance per block mined to drop 1 Akaishi Crystal, also without energy cost.$(br2)One covers mob drops, the other mining; together they provide a constant crystal supply.
Shared mechanics and the slot map are in the $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l) overview; the crystals they drop feed the refining line of $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).
